source_design.shell: client_actions owns one human-contributor registrar. Each optional field is guarded by its actual action owner. No broad command_palette or dev/environment/key gate enables unrelated fields.
source_design.vocabulary: terminal_remote alone retains terminal/connect-rust-server and terminal/start-rust-server. terminal_presentation_actions changes those IDs to terminal/server/connect and terminal/server/start; full D2 witnesses enable it. The change is explicit functional ownership, not MC dispatch.
source_design.legacy_availability: OpenScreenToSideAction, OpenReviewBundleAction and OpenTerminalAction are only witnessed on later8. Narrow explicit owners encode this support. New panel/direct edit/terminal presentation members are D2 owners.
source_design.constructor_api: Only OpenScreenToSideAction factory uses26.1.2 lambda versus method reference, preserving its historical generic constructor-resolution adapter.
source_design.echo_minimal: echo_action requires only client_actions on all10. No command_palette, editor, workspace, terminal, packet or program-runtime dependency. Localization carriers already exist unconditionally in actual core.
source_design.same_source_semantics: No normalizations, alternative historical source roots, Git reads in production, snapshots or compiler feature inference.
